prose: Simon Willison says a Hacker News comment pushed him to try Three.js-free 3D. He had Claude Opus 5.5 build a nudibranch-themed Faberge egg in Three.js (77 KB), then port it to vanilla JS and WebGL (98 KB). The two differ and Claude explained why in a shared transcript. He finds Three.js code easier to read but rarely reads the code.
highlights: Same 3D scene in Three.js (77 KB) and vanilla WebGL (98 KB)
basis: Short comment on a Hacker News thread about Paul Ford's essay
